subject: Turbosys EIN ambiguity and request for PO exception
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.k@turbosys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@turbosys.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Initial W-8BEN-E submission — EIN/TIN discrepancy

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. We uploaded a completed W-8BEN-E to your vendor portal last night (attached PDF) but noticed your system flagged an EIN/TIN mismatch. Turbosys is a US-headquartered entity but our payments team sometimes uses the DBA tax alias which caused the mismatch on our side.

Quick summary:
- Company: Turbosys Inc.
- Legal EIN (IRS): 12-3456789
- W-8BEN-E uploaded lists: 12-3456789 (but portal flagged as 123456789)

Can you let us know what evidence you need to clear the PO pipeline? We can provide a bank letter or an IRS acceptance letter — whichever helps speed the PO. We’re on a tight timeline for a Q1 integration payment.

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_Turbosys_signed.pdf (uploaded to portal)

Thanks,
Sara Klein
Head of Finance Operations
Turbosys Inc.
sara.k@turbosys.com
+1 (415) 555-2121

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Klein <sara.k@turbosys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial W-8BEN-E submission — EIN/TIN discrepancy

Sara —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the upload. A few notes and an ask so we can get the PO moving:

1) The portal validation is strict about numeric formatting. From the portal extraction the EIN dropped the leading zero in one field (shows as 123456789). That explains the automated mismatch.

2) For procurement/finance to clear the PO we need one of the following: a) a bank letter on bank letterhead showing the full EIN + account name, b) a scanned IRS EIN confirmation letter (CP 575 or equivalent), OR c) an updated W-8BEN-E with a notarized signature if the signatory name differs from the portal profile.

3) Because Turbosys flagged time pressure, we can provisionally create the PO with a payment hold and a conditional release clause — but that needs approval from Finance (Rishi). If Finance approves we’ll issue PO "pending verification" (payments will not be released until evidence is validated).

Can you confirm which evidence you’ll provide and an ETA? If you can upload the bank letter, please include the account name and EIN exactly as printed. If you prefer DocuSign for a notarized W-8, send the link.

Attachment: procurement-onboarding-checklist.pdf (reference)

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Initial W-8BEN-E submission — EIN/TIN discrepancy

Team —

Reviewed Sara's upload (bank letter + updated W-8). The bank letter is on bank letterhead and explicitly lists EIN 12-3456789 matching the W-8. Finance is comfortable approving a conditional PO exception with the following controls:

- PO status: ISSUED (payment_hold)
- Release trigger: finance validates bank letter and W-8 match and confirms beneficiary banking details (expected within 5 business days)
- Limit: initial invoice capped at $50k until full verification complete

Hannah — please create the PO in Coupa with the "payment_hold" flag and note the DocuSign link in the PO comments. Attach the PO-EXCEPTION-APPROVAL.pdf to the PO record (attached). Monica — please batch this into Friday’s verification queue; match the EIN printed on the bank letter to the vendor profile and escalate any residual format mismatches to Legal.

Once the verification completes, Finance will change status to RELEASED and trigger payment. If anything looks inconsistent escalate to me directly.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Finance, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: PO-EXCEPTION-APPROVAL.pdf
